profile.headline: Engineer at Bluebeam
profile.summary: Science, technology, and learning have been passions of mine throughout my entire life. Even as a small child I would tell everyone that I wanted to be a scientist. Since I was lucky to grow up in a time of emerging technology, I also developed an immense interest in technology. It took me a while to get to a point where I realized I could find a career that fits both of my interests, but after a career change and a lot of hard work, I made my way into software engineering. Now I spend every day doing work that I enjoy in an environment where continuous learning is both encouraged and needed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Using DynamoDb, Express.js, Angular.js/React.js, and Node.js – assisted senior engineers in building and maintaining Bluebeam Atlas (formerly Project Atlas). Used functional and object-oriented programming, along with AWS services, to build and maintain Atlas’s document storage service.

positions.title: Director
positions.description:
Find speakers and host events
Facilitate discussions in slack community
Provide mentorship and support to members of Women Who Code

positions.title: IT Development Intern
positions.description:
Assisted CSS development team with web development templates using Aurelia framework, Visual Studio Enterprise, typescript, and C#. Used Team Foundation Server 2015 to create product and project queries, document project work, and monitor assigned tasks. Assisted with quality analysis
manual and automated testing and added new functionality and design to team templates using Aurelia framework.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed, coded, modified, and provided content for websites, from layout to function and according to client specifications. Created search engine optimized, accessible, and visually appealing site features with user-friendly design and clear navigation.

positions.title: Physical Therapy Technician
positions.description: Worked with patients recovering from surgery or injury to return to normal activities by assessing the patients condition and creating a plan to help the patient recover.

positions.title: Health Care Specialist/Physical Therapy Specialist
positions.description:
Worked with other clinicians to treat patients and maintain clinic safety.
Met with individual patients to asses injuries and worked with them in individualized treatment plans.
